profile.overview: Witherbloom College is a black-green college associated with Arcavios / Strixhaven.
profile.philosophy: Life and death are living essences to study, brew, heal with, bargain with, and weaponize.
profile.core_tension: Witherbloom splits between nurturing ecosystems and exploiting life essence for personal or practical power.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guides frame Witherbloom as the College of Essence Studies, with mages at home in swamps, labs, clinics, and dangerous fieldwork.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Witherbloom identity centers on life gain, pests, sacrifice, healing, harm, and biological exchange.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: This is a compact first-pass JSON package generated from official overview and mechanics sources.
